title: Multi-source product catalog deduplication and normalization
objective: Create a canonical product catalog with exact source mapping, normalized units and explicit unresolved identity/attribute conflicts.

tasks.title: Normalize retail channel records
tasks.description: Normalize and cluster the source_skus assigned to this task in data/scopes.json. Produce the scoped catalog artifact defined in README.md.
tasks.requirements: Use all assigned source records and declared identity dimensions; preserve model suffixes and distinguish packs, decimal capacity units, and physical dimensions. Report attribute conflicts and uncertain sources. A shared boundary product deliberately occurs in both scopes.

tasks.title: Normalize business channel records
tasks.description: Normalize and cluster the source_skus assigned to this task in data/scopes.json. Produce the scoped catalog artifact defined in README.md.
tasks.requirements: Use all assigned source records and declared identity dimensions; preserve model suffixes and distinguish packs, decimal capacity units, and physical dimensions. Report attribute conflicts and uncertain sources. A shared boundary product deliberately occurs in both scopes.

tasks.title: Prepare optional supplier clarification evidence
tasks.description: Identify all unresolved source identities and top-priority attribute disagreements across the entire catalog.
tasks.requirements: Return findings using the uncertain schema and evidence_rows containing the physical row IDs supporting those findings. Do not guess missing model/pack information from marketing titles. This report is optional.
